analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($532.52) vs SMA5 ($523.60)/SMA20 ($530.81)/SMA50 ($566.81) — above short-term, below mid-term.
· High position relative to SMA100 ($495.26)/SMA200 ($407.37) — maintaining mid-to-long term trend strength.
· 52-week position (70.5%) — in a declining phase from historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (48.4→48.8) — continuing neutral range, lack of direction.
· MACD histogram trajectory (2.2840→2.2840) — weakening improvement, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $530.81) — consolidating near the mid-band, bandwidth at 20.51% is normal.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($522.24) — above Pivot S1 ($469.14).
· Swing resistance ($533.74) — potential for short-term upside breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low patterns — consolidation, no clear Higher Low or Lower High formed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.62x) — contracted relative to average, reduced conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to lack of direction.
